audience: Participants in an invented library workshop comparing catalog notes.
production_constraints: Prepare a written discussion outline with a written opening, ordered developed points and examples, adjacent bridges, close, audience question, estimated finished length and useful production notes.
Use a neutral workshop frame. Ask for a catalog observation, counterexample or missing evidence without announcing availability or an event.
Label every invented comparison and mock demonstration hypothetical. Synthetic historical excerpts cannot authenticate a current real-world finding.
Keep selected idea, hook and source traceability on every component. Do not transfer the invented organizer identity to a real user or revive the withdrawn May 17 workshop date.
Provide planned production actions with observable completion checks. Remove unsupported factual wording or label it as an assumption with linked verification before use.
Do not publish, contact anyone, perform research, mark planned work complete or fabricate human confirmation.
Use exactly 3 developed key points, 4 adjacent written bridges from opening through the 3 points to close, 2 production notes and 2-3 concrete planned actions with observable completion checks.
